agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom meeting no. 865 2199 1629
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak, or submit written comments is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: 2026 City of Ottawa Municipal Accessibility Plan (COMAP) Update
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Megan Richards, Program Manager, Accessibility, Legislative Services, Office of the City Clerk and Sarah Beriault, Accessibility Specialist, Legislative Services, Office of the City Clerk provided a presentation and answered questions from the Advisory Committee. A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
The Advisory Committee then heard from the following delegation:
1. Kyle Humphrey.
The Advisory Committee discussed, asked questions and provided feedback regarding the COMAP Update.
Following discussion, the Advisory Committee received the presentation.

motions.motion_text: That the Accessibility Advisory Committee receive the presentation and provide feedback as appropriate.
